Extract from D.S.I. Golder's report of (Shanghai Power Co.
Situation) on October 26, 1933.
Zung Ching Loh ( 陳子祿 ), wounded employee,
now lying in the Sacred Heart Hospital, shows a slight
improvement since yesterday.
Since the attempted murder of Zung Ching Loh
on October 20, here have been no further cases of
intimidation reported. Enquiries into the shooting have
produced no useful information, the strikers, however,
though their union have taken every opportunity to disclaim
all connection with the affair.
(October 28, 1933.)
Zung Ching Loh, staff employee who was shot and
wounded on October 20, and who is at present lying in
the Sacred Heart Hospital, continues to show slight
improvement.
(October 31, 1933.)
Zung Ching Loh, employee of the Company who
was shot on October 20, continues to make progress
towards recovery. In connection with the attempted murder

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, OCTOBER 23, 1933

S.P.C. EMPLOYEE
SHOOTING

Union Denies Liability
In Council Visit

NANKING DELEGATE'S
INVESTIGATIONS

Reference is made in Chinese
newspaper reports regarding the
Shanghai Power Co. strike to the
despatch of Mr. Pao Kuo-hwa,
chief of the Fourth Section of the
Labour Bureau, by the Ministry of
Industry to make personal in-
vestigations in Shanghai in view of
the serious proportions which the
stoppage has now assumed. All
documents in the case are said to
have been submitted to him by the
Social Affairs Bureau, and discus-
sion as to steps to be taken took
place between officials of the bureau
and the Nanking delegate. It was
anticipated that representatives
would be appointed by the General
Labour Union yesterday to submit
a report to Mr. Pao.
Representatives of the Fourth
District Water and Electricity
Labour Union were on Saturday
morning granted an interview with
Mr. A. D. Bell, chairman of the
Shanghai Municipal Council, and
Mr. Ho Teh-kwei, Chinese assist-
ant secretary to the Council. In re-
ply to questions concerning the
shooting of Chen Ching-loh, one of
the company's staff, for the con-
viction of whose assailants the
management have offered a reward
of $5,000, representatives denied
that the attempted assassination
had any connection with the labour-
ers on strike. An intimation was
given, according to Chinese sources,
that the Council would endeavour
to assist towards a settlement of
the strike, and that meanwhile good
order must be maintained.

Other Labour Troubles
Spokesmen of the district Rolled
Tobacco Workers' Union on Satur-
day called on the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai as well as the
Bureau of Social Affairs and the
local Tangpu to submit a petition
with respect to the "go slow" strike
declared several days ago in the
British Cigarette Co. factory. Offi-
cials gave undertaking to submit
proposals to the management.
A further meeting between em-
ployers and employees in the dyers'
strike has been called for to-day,
previous conciliation attempts hav-
ing proved vain. At present work-
ers are refusing to dye goods for
firms, but accepting orders from in-
dividual customers. Dyeing shops
are functioning as usual.

Nanking Interested
Nanking, Oct. 22.
The Ministry of Industry is pay-
ing attention to the strike of em-
ployees of the Shanghai Power Co.
Interviewed here to-day by Chi-
nese pressmen prior to his depar-
ture for Shanghai Mr. Pao Kuo-
hua, director of the department of
labour of the Ministry, stated that
he would inquire into the causes of
the trouble and co-operate with the
local authorities in possible means
for a settlement.

《字林西报》，1933年10月23日，星期一

上海电力公司职员
枪击案

工会在访晤公董局时
否认承担责任

南京代表展开调查

中文报纸关于上海电力公司罢工的报道中提到，鉴于停工事态已变得严重，实业部委派劳工局第四科科长鲍国华先生亲赴上海进行调查。据悉，社会局已将该案所有文件提交给他，该局官员与南京代表就采取何种步骤进行了讨论。预计总工会昨日将指派代表向鲍先生提交报告。

第四区水电业工会代表于周六上午获准会见了上海公共租界工部局总董A. D. Bell先生及工部局华籍助理秘书何德奎先生。在回答有关该公司一名职员陈庆禄（Chen Ching-loh）遭枪击一事的问题时——管理层为缉拿并定罪袭击者已悬赏5,000美元——代表们否认此次未遂暗杀与罢工工人有任何关联。据中方消息人士透露，会上暗示工部局将努力协助解决罢工问题，同时必须维持良好秩序。

其他劳资纠纷

区卷烟业工会发言人于周六拜会了大上海市政府、社会局及当地塘浦办事处，就数日前在英商烟草公司工厂宣布的“怠工”罢工提交请愿书。官员们承诺将向资方提出建议。

由于此前的调解尝试均告无效，印染业罢工中的劳资双方会议定于今日再次举行。目前，工人们拒绝为各商行染色货物，但接受个人客户的订单。染坊照常营业。

南京方面表示关注

南京，10月22日电。
实业部正关注上海电力公司职员的罢工事件。该部劳工司司长鲍国华先生在前往上海前，今日在此接受中国记者采访时称，他将调查纠纷起因，并与地方当局合作寻求可能的解决办法。

JBR 10/23

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, OCTOBER 23, 1933

INQUIRY ON POWER
COMPANY CLERK

Investigation By S.M.C.
And Labour Ministry
Into Shooting

The attempted assassination by strikers on Friday of Zung Ching-loh, a clerk of the Shanghai Power Company, has caused a furore in certain Chinese circles, according to the Chinese newspapers, which stated yesterday that Mr. A. D. Bell, Chairman of the S.M.C., had made inquiries into the event.

The "Chen Pao" and other newspapers stated that Mr. Bell on Saturday with Mr. Ho Teh-kwei, Assistant Secretary to the S.M.C., had talked with certain labour union leaders who declared that the shooting had nothing to do with the walkout of the Power Company workers.

Other inquiries are being made by Mr. Pao Kuo-hwa, a representative from the Ministry of Labour, who arrived here from Nanking on Friday, it was said. Mr. Pao has talked with Mr. O. K. Yde, secretary of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, and with officials of the Bureau of Social Affairs, it was declared, but the results were not announced.

In the meantime, the police of both the Settlement and the Chinese territories are keeping a sharp lookout for the three strikers who kidnapped Zung on Friday morning, and shot and left him for dead in a field outside the Settlement boundary near the Chinese Jockey Club grounds.

The Power Company has offered a reward of $5,000 for the capture of the gunmen.

对电力公司职员遇袭案的调查

工部局与劳工部
调查枪击事件

据中文报纸称，周五罢工者对上海电力公司职员钟庆禄（Zung Ching-loh，译注：此处英文拼写与前文略有不同，依原文音译或参照前文陈庆禄）的未遂暗杀在某些华人圈子中引起了轰动，这些报纸昨天称，工部局总董A. D. Bell先生已对此事展开问询。

《申报》及其他报纸称，Bell先生周六会同工部局助理秘书何德奎先生与某些工会领袖进行了谈话，后者宣称枪击事件与电力公司工人的罢工无关。

与此同时，租界和华界的警方都在严密搜捕周五上午绑架钟某、并在其开枪后将其弃尸于跑马总会附近租界边界外田野中的三名罢工者。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, OCTOBER 22, 1933    7474

$5,000 Reward Offered For
Arrest Of Gunmen

Shanghai Power Company Seeking Conviction Of
Persons Responsible For Putting Employee
"On The Spot"; Strike Continues

Leaving no stone unturned in their efforts to secure the arrest and conviction of the persons responsible for the attempted killing of Zung Ching-loh, an employee of the Shanghai Power Company, who was found grievously wounded in the neighbourhood of the Ying Hsiang Kiang race course, in Chinese territory, on Friday morning, the Power Company have offered a reward of $5,000 for the arrest and conviction of the persons responsible for the crime. Officials of the Company are working hand-in-hand with the police in an endeavour to bring home the crime to the men who took the victim for "a ride" and pumped four bullets into his body as an act of intimidation to other workers who have, thus far, refused to join the strike of workmen of the maintenance staff of the electricity company. The victim who was discovered early Friday morning and removed to hospital in a serious condition is still alive, but there was little hope held for his recovery yesterday.

There was no outward indication among loyal workers yesterday that the intimidation methods of the strikers had any effect on the morale of those remaining at work. So far the strike of the maintenance men has in no way interfered with the Settlement's electricity supply and the community has in no way been inconvenienced by the walk-out. The attempted murder has, on the other hand, raised considerable indignation among the loyal workers and there is every possibility that an arrest will be made as the result of information forthcoming from persons acquainted with the activities of the radical elements among the strikers.

Efforts have been made by the strike committee and union leaders to bring out the remainder of the employees of the Company, but apart from a short-lived absence of a section of the clerical workers on October 10, the majority of whom subsequently returned to work, these attempts have proved fruitless. The employment of a large number of Russians in place of the striking maintenance men has kept the service at practically normal capacity and others are to be engaged if the men prolong the strike which has lasted since September 29.

Act Of Sabotage

An inquiry late last evening elicited the information that all was still quiet in connection with the dispute. There was, however, one small act of sabotage reported, this being from the Pootoo Road district. Some person unknown had smashed one of the switch boxes attached to a telephone pole, breaking off the handle. This did not, however, interfere with the supply of current.

B. C. C. Strike

The situation at the British Cigarette Company is much the same. The factory is idle as the "go-slow" strike continues. The hands report for duty each morning and remain on the premises for about half an hour after which they depart for their homes when the machinery is not set in motion. Several hundred workers in the leafcutting department of the factory are responsible for the strike which involves approximately 2,800 hands.
pages.zh:
《上海星期泰晤士报》，1933年10月22日    7474

悬赏5,000美元
缉拿枪手

上海电力公司寻求定罪对员工实施“定点清除”的责任人；罢工仍在继续

上海电力公司为不遗余力地确保逮捕并定罪企图杀害其雇员钟庆禄（Zung Ching-loh）的责任人，已于周五早晨在华界引翔江跑马场附近发现其受重伤后，提供5,000美元奖金以逮捕并定罪罪犯。公司官员正与警方通力合作，力求将罪行归咎于那些将受害者“带走兜风”并向其体内连开四枪的人，此举旨在恐吓其他至今拒绝加入电力公司维修部门工人罢工的工人。受害者于周五清晨被发现，送医时情况危急，目前仍存活，但昨天对其康复几乎不抱希望。

昨天，忠诚的员工中没有任何外在迹象表明罢工者的恐吓手段对留守工作人员的士气产生了影响。到目前为止，维修工人的罢工丝毫没有干扰租界的电力供应，社区也未因停工而受到任何不便。另一方面，这起未遂谋杀案在忠诚员工中激起了相当大的愤慨，鉴于熟悉罢工者中激进分子活动的人士可能提供情报，极有可能因此实现逮捕。

罢工委员会和工会领袖曾努力动员公司其余员工参与罢工，但除了10月10日部分文员短暂缺勤（其中大多数人随后返岗）外，这些尝试均证明徒劳无功。雇佣大量俄罗斯人替代罢工的维修工人，使服务保持在几乎正常的容量，如果这些人延长自9月29日持续至今的罢工，还将雇用更多人。

破坏行为

昨晚深夜的调查获悉，纠纷方面一切仍然平静。然而，据报道发生了一起轻微的破坏行为，地点在普陀路地区。某个不明身份的人砸坏了附着在电话线杆上的一个开关盒，折断了手柄。但这并未干扰电流供应。

英商烟草公司罢工

英商烟草公司的情况大致相同。由于“怠工”罢工仍在继续，工厂处于闲置状态。工人们每天早晨报到，在厂内停留约半小时，当机器未启动时便回家。工厂切叶部门的数百名工人引发了这次涉及约2,800名工人的罢工。

Further to Misc. File No. 80
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Yangtzepoo Station,
REPORT
Date Oct. 22nd, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Further to Attempted Murder of an Employee of the Shanghai
Power Co. named Lung Ching Hoh.

Made by and Forwarded by S.I. Willgoss

Sir,
the instructions of the S.D., "D" C.I.S. 87 and 62 of
Rayside Station and C.I.S. 14 and 11 of Yulin Road Station have
been loaned to Yangtzepoo Station to assist in the enquiries
into this case.
During the forenoon of 21st October 1933 C.I.S. 62
learned that in September 1932 a group photograph of the Clerical
Staff of the S.P.C. was taken by the Ah Fong Studio Nanking Road.
The undersigned and C.I.S. 62 proceeded to the Ah Fong Studio at
11 a.m. 21st inst and were successful in tracing the plate. A
print was immediately made and taken to the Riverside Power Station
and shown to a certain member of the Clerical Staff there who
pointed out the man Woo Tsu Pei who is suspected of having insti-
gated this crime.
By arrangement with I.S. Mason who was on duty at the Finger
Print Bureau during the afternoon of 21st inst copies of
Woo Tsu Pei's photograph were taken and distributed among the
detectives who are enquiring into this case.
C.I.Ss 14 and 11 have been detailed to keep observation at the
Picketing Group Committee's Headquarters at Lane 191, No. 16
Thorburn Road so that in the event of Tsu Ah Fon, who is a member
of that committee, visiting the place he can be arrested.
The two rounds of ammunition and the empty cartridge case
found at the scene of the crime were taken to the Arms Identifica-
tion Section on the morning of the 21st inst and examined by D.S.I.
Borner who discovered that the three items had been ejected from the
breech of the same firearm. There is no previous record. If
the bullet at present lodged in the buttock of the victim is
extracted, a further test will be made.

主题（全称） 续上海电力公司名为龙庆和（Lung Ching Hoh，译注：此处英文名与前文Zung Ching Loh/Chen Ching-loh不同，照实译出）职员遭未遂谋杀案。

由特别巡捕 Willgoss 制作并转发

先生，
遵照刑事侦缉处主任指示，雷司德捕房的刑事侦缉员87号和62号，以及榆林路捕房的刑事侦缉员14号和11号，已被借调至杨树浦捕房以协助本案调查。
1933年10月21日上午，刑事侦缉员62号获悉，1932年9月，阿芳照相馆（南京路）曾拍摄上海电力公司文职员工的集体照。卑职与刑事侦缉员62号于本月21日上午11时前往阿芳照相馆，成功找到了底片。立即制作了一张照片，并带至江边发电厂，出示给那里的一位文职员工，该员工指认了吴祖培（Woo Tsu Pei）男子，此人涉嫌煽动此罪行。
经与本月21日下午在指纹局值班的督察 Mason 安排，拍摄了吴祖培照片的副本，并分发给正在调查此案的侦探。
刑事侦缉员14号和11号已被派往索恩本路16号191弄的纠察队委员会总部进行监视，以便在该委员会成员朱阿凤（Tsu Ah Fon，音译）到访时将其逮捕。
在犯罪现场发现的两发子弹和一个空弹壳于本月21日上午被送往武器鉴定科，并由副督察 Borner 进行检查，他发现这三件物品是从同一支枪械的枪膛中射出的。此前无记录。如果从受害者臀部取出目前嵌在那里的子弹，将进行进一步测试。

Diary for information of the Commissioner of Police
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Special Branch,
October 20, 1933.

Shanghai Power Company - Shooting of Employee

At 8.25 a.m. October 20, Zung Ching-loh
(陳慶祿), Stores Accountant's Clerk of the Shanghai
Power Company, left his home at 17 Peh Tsang Ka Loong (?),
City, to proceed to work. He had only proceeded
a few yards when he was met by six or seven men who
pushed him towards a waiting (private motor car ?)
(number unknown). All got in and rode for about a
half mile when the car was stopped at the request of
one of the passengers, who got out and telephoned
for another car. Upon the arrival of the second
vehicle (a Ford) the party divided themselves between
the two cars and proceeded by various roads to a point
about a half mile north of the Ying Hsiang Kiang Village
on the Ma Ngoeh San Road. The cars were stopped,
the party dismounted and the cars were dismissed. As
soon as the conveyances had got out of sight two of the
men drew pistols and fired at Zung Ching-loh. The
party of men then apparently dispersed and the wounded
man lay for some time on the roadside. Some while
later he was seen by a pedestrian who called a ricsha
and conveyed the man to the Settlement. At the Police
Telephone Box, Ying Hsiang Kiang Village, the wounded man
and his rescuer were met by F.P.S. Gavenlock attached
to Yangtszepoo Station, who took them to the Sacred
Heart Hospital. Zung Ching-loh is suffering from a
bullet wound in the left side of the chest near the
heart, and another in the groin, whilst his scalp shows
several lacerated wounds.

1933年10月20日。

上海电力公司——职员遭枪击事件

10月20日上午8时25分，上海电力公司存货会计员办事员陈庆祿（Zung Ching-loh）离开位于华界北张家弄17号（?）的住所前往上班。他刚走出几码远，便遇到六七名男子，这些人将他推向一辆等候着的（私人汽车？）（车牌号码不详）。所有人上车后行驶了约半英里，随后应其中一名乘客的要求停车，该乘客下车打电话叫另一辆车。第二辆车（一辆福特汽车）到达后，这伙人分乘两辆车，经由不同道路驶至马玉山路（Ma Ngoeh San Road）上营房江村（Ying Hsiang Kiang Village）以北约半英里处。车辆停下，众人下车并遣散车辆。交通工具刚一驶离视线，其中两名男子便拔出手枪向陈庆祿射击。随后这伙人似乎四散而去，受伤者倒在路边一段时间。过了一会儿，一名路人发现了他，叫了一辆人力车将其送往租界。在营房江村的警亭，伤者和施救者遇到了隶属于杨树浦巡捕房的洋籍警员加文洛克（Gavenlock），他将他们送往圣心医院。陈庆祿左胸近心脏处中一弹，腹股沟处中一弹，头皮有多处撕裂伤。

Whilst still conscious Zung gave the names of two of
his assailants as being "Ah Foh" and "Ah Lien". He
also mentioned the name of Wu Tsoo-Bei (吳祖培), but whether
this person was actually at the scene of the shooting
is not known.

Zung together with others was publicly
denounced by the Shanghai Power Company strikers in the
Chen Pao and other newspapers on October 17 as being
a spy for the management. He and one other of the
men accused of duplicity made reply in the China Times
of October 18 denouncing the statement as a falsehood.
Wu Tsoo-Bei together with Faung Chien (方謙) and
Tung Tien-kong (董天元), all clerks in the employ of
the Shanghai Power Company were responsible for the
formation of the Staff Employees' Strike Committee
on October 11 and subsequent efforts to cause the
clerical staff to strike.

Ah-Foh is suspected of referring to Tsu
Ah-foh (朱阿福), P.E.X. 17, employed at Riverside
Power Station and residing at 322 Tiendong Road, is
a member of the Workers' Strike Committee and member
of the "Picketing Groups" Committee. He has been
active throughout the present dispute.

Ah-Lien. No trace of this man can be found.

10月17日，上海电力公司罢工者在《晨报》及其他报纸上公开谴责陈庆祿等人是管理层的密探。他和另一名被指控两面派的男子于10月18日在《字林西报》（China Times）上发表回复，称该说法为谎言。吴祖培与方謙（Faung Chien）、董天元（Tung Tien-kong）均为上海电力公司职员，他们负责于10月11日组建职员罢工委员会，并随后试图煽动文职人员罢工。

“阿福”疑似指朱阿福（Tsu Ah-foh），工号17，受雇于江边发电厂，居住在天潼路322号，是工人罢工委员会成员及“纠察队”委员会成员。他在目前的纠纷中一直表现活跃。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, OCTOBER 21, 1933

Strikers Kidnap And Shoot
Power Company Employee

Yesterday's Affair Most Serious In Three Week's
Walkout; Betrayal Claimed In Chinese Press;
Indignant Management Makes Statement

The Shanghai Power Company strike situation was aroused from a week's apathy yesterday by the kidnapping and shooting of a loyal clerk of the head office.

The victim, Zung Chang-loh, was seized early yesterday when he left his Nantao home on the way to work. He was taken in a private automobile to the General Labour Union Office at 117 Foh-yu, Chinese City, and questioned. Three men then called a hire car, placed Zung in it, and drove out towards the Chinese Jockey Club. When about a mile past the Settlement boundary, the car was stopped and dismissed, and the trio, with their captive, took to a near-by field.

At the edge of a creek, the captive was shot and left for dead while the assailants fled.

Rescued By Farmers
Farmers discovered Zung lying on the bank of the creek and helped him into a ricsha which sped towards the Settlement and hospital aid. The ricsha was forced to stop at the Settlement boundary, not having a Settlement licence; and an S.M.P. radio police van discovered Zung while the ricsha coolie was searching for a Settlement ricsha. The victim was in a semi-conscious condition and was taken to the Sacred Heart Hospital, where he was found to be suffering from bullet wounds in the chest and groin. Needless to say, his state is most serious. The affair was communicated to the Chinese police, who, with Settlement authorities, are keeping a sharp lookout for the perpetrators of the deed. It is thought that the affair is the outcome of accusations from certain of the strike leaders. On Tuesday an article derived from certain of the strike leaders was published in one of the Chinese newspapers. It accused Zung of double-crossing the strikers, for whom he was supposed to be working.

Revenge Of Strike Leaders
Zung replied on the following day (Wednesday) through an article in the vernacular press and denied having anything to do with the strike. It is said on good authority that the shooting was an act of retribution on the part of the strike leaders, and that the order for the deed was given by a certain one of them.

The shooting is the most serious occurrence to take place since the start of the strike some three weeks ago. Over a week ago, four loyal employees were mildly assaulted at the Chapel office of the General Labour Union, some 6 clerks were forced to attend a meeting one morning instead of going to work, and one bombing was attempted.

The management of the Company has taken the attitude that there is no strike, and that some 95 per cent. of the workers have been forced to quit work. Consequently, the Company will listen with sympathy to any of the 95 per cent. who apply for work.

The shooting yesterday caused much indignation among the Power Company officials, and an announcement was issued explaining the Company's attitude and its side on the strike situation.

Company Statement
First telling of the outrage yesterday, which part has been deleted, the announcement states:
"After a reign of terror by beatings, bombings and finally by an armed attack in broad daylight, the pressure of intimidation is being waged by radical labour leaders.
"It is to be hoped that the public will finally realize that the industrious and honest labourers of the Company have for a long time before this strike been forced by threats of violence to give up part of their hard earned pay to radical strike leaders so that strike leaders could live in luxury without work.
"Over 95 per cent. of the Company's employees are industrious and law abiding, and wish to work in peace.
"The Company has repeatedly stated it would be glad to retain this 95 per cent. of its employees. The only reason they were forced to strike and are unable to return is fear of the radical strike leaders' violent intimidation by use of bombs and shooting.
"The public will undoubtedly realize now the type of strike leaders that have been trying to gain public sympathy by untrue statements and realize the sort of people that have been making life intolerable for the Company's honest employees.
"It is hoped that the time has come when the authorities and others interested in the preservation of law and order should refrain from their passive tolerance of armed aggressive labour leaders who are strengthening their grip of terror upon the community on the one hand by their false pleas for consideration by deliberate lies and falsehoods, while upon the other hand they terrorize their fellow workers with a view to impressing the public that the labourers are in fact dissatisfied or oppressed by the Company.
"The Company recognizes its responsibility to the public to maintain its service upon which the law, order and industries of this port are wholly or partly dependent. The service has and will be maintained but it cannot allow terrorists and murderers to have access to its plant and equipment.
"It is not a struggle between employer and employee. It is a struggle between honest, conservative labourers and radical leaders—an unequal struggle in which the radicals are armed and backed by Moral support by the public and reliance upon facts will greatly aid the restoration of peace."

《字林西报》，1933年10月21日，星期六

罢工者绑架并枪击
电力公司职员

昨日事件为三周罢工以来最严重之事；中文报刊声称存在背叛行为；愤慨的管理层发表声明

随着总部一名忠诚职员遭到绑架和枪击，上海电力公司的罢工局势昨日从一周的冷漠状态中被重新激起。

受害者张宗洛（Zung Chang-loh，音译）于昨日清晨离开南市住所去上班途中被劫持。他被带上一辆私人汽车，送至华界法租界路117号（Foh-yu，音译）的总工会办事处接受审问。随后三名男子叫了一辆出租车，将张宗洛放入车内，向中国赛马会方向驶去。当驶过租界边界约一英里时，车辆停下并被遣散，这三名男子带着俘虏进入附近的一片田地。

在一条小溪边，俘虏遭到枪击并被弃之等死，袭击者随即逃窜。

被农民救起
农民发现张宗洛躺在溪岸边，帮助他上了一辆人力车，该车迅速驶向租界寻求医院救助。由于没有租界执照，人力车被迫在租界边界停下；此时，一辆公共租界警务处的无线电警车发现了张宗洛，当时人力车夫正在寻找一辆有租界执照的人力车。受害者处于半昏迷状态，被送往圣心医院，经查胸部和腹股沟有中弹伤。毋庸赘言，他的情况非常危急。此事已通报中国警方，他们正与租界当局密切配合，严密搜捕作案凶手。据信，此事是某些罢工领袖指控的结果。周二，一家中文报纸刊登了一篇源自某些罢工领袖的文章。文章指责张宗洛背叛了罢工者，而他本被认为是在为罢工者工作。

罢工领袖的报复
张宗洛次日（周三）通过中文报刊发表文章予以回应，否认与罢工有任何关联。据可靠消息来源称，枪击事件是罢工领袖的报复行为，且行动命令由其中某一人下达。

此次枪击是自三周前罢工开始以来发生的最严重事件。一周多前，四名忠诚员工在总工会礼拜堂办事处遭到轻微殴打，约六名职员在某天早晨被迫参加会议而非去上班，还发生了一起未遂的炸弹袭击事件。

公司管理层采取的态度是，不存在罢工，约95%的工人是被迫停工的。因此，公司将同情地听取这95%中任何申请复工者的诉求。

昨日的枪击事件在电力公司官员中引起了极大愤慨，公司发布了一份公告，解释公司在罢工局势中的立场和观点。

公司声明
公告首先讲述了昨日发生的暴行（部分已删除），内容如下：
“在经历了殴打、炸弹袭击，最后是大白天的武装攻击这一恐怖统治之后，激进劳工领袖正在施加恐吓压力。
“希望公众最终能认识到，本公司勤劳诚实的劳工在此次罢工之前很久，就因暴力威胁而被迫将部分辛苦挣得的工资交给激进罢工领袖，以便这些领袖不劳而获地过着奢侈生活。
“公司超过95%的员工勤劳守法，希望和平工作。
“公司曾多次表示，很高兴留用这95%的员工。他们被迫罢工且无法返回的唯一原因，是害怕激进罢工领袖使用炸弹和枪击进行暴力恐吓。
“公众现在无疑会认识到，那些试图通过不实陈述博取公众同情的罢工领袖是何种类型的人，并认清那些让公司诚实员工生活变得难以忍受的是些什么样的人。
“希望时机已经成熟，当局及其他关心维护法律与秩序的人士，不应再被动容忍武装的侵略性劳工领袖，他们一方面通过蓄意撒谎和虚假陈述恳求体谅，另一方面恐吓其工友，旨在给公众留下劳工确实对公司不满或受压迫的印象，从而加强对社区的恐怖控制。
“公司承认其对公众负有责任，需维持本港法律、秩序和工业完全或部分依赖的服务。服务一直并将继续维持，但公司不能允许恐怖分子和凶手接触其厂房和设备。
“这不是雇主与雇员之间的斗争。这是诚实、保守的劳工与激进领袖之间的斗争——这是一场不平等的斗争，激进派拥有武装，并得到公众的道德支持。依靠事实将极大地有助于恢复和平。”

October 21, 3.

Labour (3)

At 8.25 a.m. October 20, a Store Accountants'
Clerk named Chen Tsing-loh (陳慶祿) left his home
at 17 North Tsang Ka Loong (北張家弄), City, on his
way to work. A few yards from his house he was stopped
by six or seven men and conveyed by motor car to a point
near the General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City.
At this place a hire car was called and the party split
up. Both cars then proceeded to Ma Yueh San Road to
a point about a mile north of Yinghsiangkiang Village in
Chinese territory where the victim and his assailants
alighted and the cars were paid off. The clerk was then
taken by his captors across a field to a spot about 100
yards away from the road where seven shots were fired
at him, wounding him in three places. He was left
lying there and was subsequently picked up by countrymen
and conveyed to the 5th District 5th Sub-Station at
Yinghsiangkiang Village and from there he was sent to the
Sacred Heart Hospital, Mingkue Road.

An examination showed him to have sustained bullet
wounds in the chest and right groin and he is detained
in the Hospital in a serious condition.

The company has authorized the issue of a reward of
$5,000.00 for information leading to the arrest of the
assailants of the victim, Chen Tsing-loh.
pages.zh:
10月21日，3.

劳工（3）

10月20日上午8时25分，一名名为陈庆祿（Chen Tsing-loh）的存货会计员办事员离开其位于华界北张家弄17号的住所去上班。在离家几码处，他被六七名男子拦住，并由汽车载至华界法租界路117号总工会附近。在该处叫了一辆出租车，众人分头行动。两辆车随后驶往马玉山路，到达华界营房江村（Yinghsiangkiang Village）以北约一英里处，受害者和袭击者下车并付钱遣散车辆。随后，该职员被绑架者带过一片田地，到达距道路约100码的一处地点，在那里向他开了七枪，致其三处受伤。他被留在那里，随后被乡民发现，送至营房江村第五区第五分巡捕房，并从那里被送往明复路（Mingkue Road）的圣心医院。

经检查，他胸部和右腹股沟有中弹伤，目前因病情危重留在医院。

公司已授权悬赏5,000.00美元，以征集能导致逮捕受害者陈庆祿袭击者的线索。

pages.en:
Extract from D.S.I. Golder's report of (Shanghai Power Co.
Situation) on October 22, 1933.

Zung Ching Loh (陳之祿), Shanghai Power Co.
employee, who was shot and wounded on October 20
and who is at present in the Sacred Heart Hospital, is
reported to have made a slight improvement during the
past 24 hours.

Careful watch in being maintained from this
office, in co-operation with Yangtszapoo Station, for
the assailants of Zung.

Copies of photographs of Wu Tsoo Bei (吳祖培),
ex-clerk of the Shanghai Power Company, implicated in the
shooting of Zung Ching Loh, have been distributed to
Chinese members of the Special Branch, S.I, so as to
facilitate co-operation with the Station concerned.

(October 23, 1933)

Zung Ching Loh, wounded employee of the Shanghai Power
Company, is still alive but his condition shows no
further improvement.

(October 25, 1933.)

Zung Ching Loh, employee of the Company who was
shot and wounded on October 20 remains alive, but shows
little improvement. Discreet enquiries are being made in
conjunction with the Yangtszepoo Station detectives so
far, however no useful information has come to hand.

(October 27, 1933.)

Zung Ching Loh, at present lying in the Sacred
Heart Hospital continues to improve slowly. There is
now every hope of his recovery.

摘自1933年10月22日副督察长戈尔德（Golder）关于（上海电力公司局势）的报告。

上海电力公司职员陈之祿（Zung Ching Loh）于10月20日遭枪击受伤，目前住在圣心医院，据报道在过去24小时内病情略有好转。

本办公室正与杨树浦巡捕房合作，对陈之祿的袭击者保持严密监视。

涉嫌参与枪击陈之祿的上海电力公司前职员吴祖培（Wu Tsoo Bei）的照片副本已分发给特别处情报科（S.I.）的中籍警员，以便与相关巡捕房合作。

（1933年10月23日）

上海电力公司受伤职员陈之祿仍然活着，但病情未见进一步好转。

（1933年10月25日。）

10月20日遭枪击受伤的公司职员陈之祿仍然活着，但鲜有起色。目前已与杨树浦巡捕房侦探联合进行谨慎调查，然而截至目前尚未获得有用信息。

（1933年10月27日。）

目前躺在圣心医院的陈之祿病情继续缓慢好转。现在他有康复的希望。

pages.en:
Extract from D.S.I. Golder's report of (Shanghai Power Co.
Situation) October 21, 1933.

At about 9.30 a.m. three men, all dressed in coolie
clothes went to the home of a clerk named Liu Zai-hai
at 9 Soey Kong Li, Harben Road, and informed his wife that
the attempted murder of Zung Ching Loh (陸忠清) was only the
begining and that further shooting would take place over the
week end, none of the men were known to the woman.

Zung Ching Loh, Stores Accountant's clerk of the
Shanghai Power Company Head Office, who, on October 20,
was shot and wounded by armed men, strongly suspected of
having been striking employees of the Shanghai Power
Company, is still alive and according to the latest
information from the Sacred Heart Hospital has an even
chance of recovery.
pages.zh:
摘自1933年10月21日副督察长戈尔德（Golder）关于（上海电力公司局势）的报告。

上午9时30分左右，三名均身穿苦力服装的男子前往哈本路（Harben Road）瑞康里9号一名名为刘载海（Liu Zai-hai，音译）的职员家中，告知其妻子，谋杀陈忠清（Zung Ching Loh，此处中文名与上文不同，依原文译出）未遂仅仅是开始，周末还将发生进一步的枪击事件，这名妇女不认识这些人。

上海电力公司总部的存货会计员办事员陈忠清（Zung Ching Loh）于10月20日遭武装人员枪击受伤，这些人强烈怀疑是上海电力公司的罢工员工。他仍然活着，根据来自圣心医院的最新消息，他康复的几率为一半对一半。

POLITICAL

Shun Pao, (Nanking telegram):-

ARRIVAL OF NOTABLES

Mr. Wang Ching Wei, president of the Executive
Yuan, accompanied by Madame Chen Pi Chiun, his wife,
proceeded to Shanghai on the night of October 20, to
receive medical treatment at Dr. Nolli's Hospital.
He will return to Nanking in a few days.
Mr. T.V.Soong, Minister of Finance, boarded
the gunboat "Liu Sin" for Shanghai in the evening of
October 20.
According to the associates of Soong, the
finance minister will return to Nanking after one or
two weeks to call an Economic Conference.

Mr. Sun Fo, President of the Legislative
Yuan, accompanied by Pu Bin Chan, Pu Ju Lin, Dr. C.C.
Wu, and Tseu Lin will arrive in Shanghai in the
morning of October 21.

LABOUR .

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

D 5310
ASSASSINATION OF A SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY EMPLOYEE

Chen Ching Lu, age 22 is an employee in
the Materials Department of the Shanghai Power Company.
He and other employees voluntarily resumed duty on
the advice of the Company, and this act was regarded
by the striking workers of the Company as having
impaired the recent workers' strike movement.
At 8 a.m. yesterday when Chen left his
house at No.24, Changkapang lane, City, on his way to
the Kiangse Road office of the Company, he was forced
into a car by three men dressed in blue clothes.
They asked him to accompany them to a certain Workers'
Union on Fu Yu Road.
After having spent about 20 minutes in the
premises of the Union, Chen was asked to accompany
them to a certain organization at Ying-Ziang-Kong.
Although unwilling, he was forcibly taken by them in
a Ford Hire car numbered 12323 to Shekapang district
on Ma Yu San Road, Ying-Ziang-Kong.
Arrived there at about 10 a.m., they alighted
and sent the car away. Chen was then dragged to a
certain desolate place where he was shot seven times
by the three men who then made good their escape.
Sometime later, he was found lying in a pool
of blood by a police patrol of the 5th Divisional
Police of the Bureau of Public Safety, and was conveyed
to the Sacred Heart Hospital, 41 Ningkuo Road,
Yangtzepoo.

劳工

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

D 5310
上海电力公司职员遇刺案

陈景鲁，22岁，系上海电力公司材料部职员。他与其他员工听从公司建议自愿复工，此举被该公司罢工工人视为损害了最近的工人罢工运动。
昨日上午8时，陈离开位于华界张家浜弄24号的住所，前往公司江西路办事处途中，被三名身穿蓝衣的男子强行推入一辆汽车。
他们要求他随他们前往福佑路某工会。
在工会 premises 停留约20分钟后，陈被要求随他们前往引翔港某组织。
尽管他不情愿，但仍被他们强行带上一辆车牌号为12323的福特出租汽车，前往引翔港马玉山路（Ma Yu San Road）的谢家浜地区。
上午10时许抵达该地后，他们下车并将车遣走。随后陈被拖至一处荒僻之地，被那三人开枪射击七次，随后三人逃逸。
不久后，他被公安局第五区巡警发现躺在血泊中，并被送往杨树浦宁国路41号的圣心医院。

On the way to hospital, Chen related the incident to the Police who reported the matter to the Power Company and Yangtzepoo Police Station.
At 2 p.m., his family was allowed to see him. Although having undergone an operation, his condition was still serious.
The Bureau of Public Safety and the Settlement Police are now making investigations.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

In connection with the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the Ministry of Industry, according to a reporter of the Sin Sun News Agency, has detailed Pao Kuo-hwa (包國華), chief of the Labour Department, to proceed to Shanghai to make an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the strike and to assist the control organs to deal with the dispute.
Yesterday the 6th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union detailed 4 representatives to console the strikers and to contribute to the funds one day's wages of the entire body of workers amounting to $319.81. A sum of $23.70 was also donated by the 4th District Electric Apparatus Trade Workers Union.
The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union yesterday issued the following letter addressed to the workers:-
"With a view to overthrowing the oppression of the capitalists, we have instituted a "go-slow" strike for about 20 days, during the course of which it is certain that many of us have incurred hardships, but the difficulties of the members of the "Go-slow" Strike Committee exceed those of the workers. At present, public bodies are devising ways and means to support us and we should unite to save the prestige of the Chinese race. Public support will be given to us within a few days. Our slogan is 'Adhere to the decision to maintain the dignity of the Chinese race!'."

Subject (in full) Attempted Murder of an Employee of the Shanghai Power Co.
named Zung Ching Loh

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Willgoss

Sir,
At 10.30 a.m. on the 20-10-33, P.S. Gavenlock telephoned
to the station to the effect that he had conveyed to the Sacred
Heart Hospital, No. 1 Ningkuo Rd, a male Chinese who had been
shot in Chinese Territory.
The undersigned and C.D.G. 167 immediately proceeded to the
hospital and learned that the wounded man was named Zung Ching
Loh, age 22, native of Shanghai, residing at No. 17 North Tseng
Ka Loong, City, and employed as a clerk in the Stores Accounting
Department of the Shanghai Power Co., Nanking Road.
As soon as it was convenient, the injured man was questioned
and stated that at about 8.25 a.m. on the 20-10-33, he left his
home at the above address with the intention of proceeding to
office. After walking a few yards, he was stopped by six or
seven men who stated that they were going to take him to the
Labour Union Office. He was compelled to board a motor car
(believed private) which was standing nearby, and after the car
had proceeded a short distance, it was stopped because it was
overloaded. One of the injured men's captors then went away
and telephoned for a Ford Hire car and on its arrival, two of the
men pushed their victim into it and ordered the chauffeur to
drive to the Ying Ziang Kong Village, O.J.L. The car proceeded
to the Ma Nyoh San Road about a mile north of the Ying Ziang
Kong Village and then stopped, and the victim and his two
abductors alighted. The car was paid off and returned to the
Settlement, and the Victim was taken across a field to a spot
about 100 yards from the road near a small pond and there shot
twice. Subsequently, (no definite time can be stated on this
point) the victim was seen by some country people who informed

先生，
1933年10月20日上午10时30分，Gavenlock 警佐打电话到分局，称他将一名在华界被枪击的中国男子送往宁国路1号圣心医院。
本报告人及 C.D.G. 167 立即前往医院，获悉伤者名为 Zung Ching Loh，22岁，上海籍，居住于华界曾家龙北17号，受雇于南京路上海电力公司存货会计部担任职员。
在方便之时对伤者进行了询问，他陈述说，1933年10月20日上午8时25分左右，他离开上述地址的家，打算去办公室。走了几码后，他被六七名男子拦住，这些人声称要带他去工会办公室。他被迫登上附近停着的一辆汽车（据信为私家车），车行驶了一小段距离后因超载而停下。其中一名劫持者离开并打电话叫了一辆福特出租汽车，车到达后，两人将受害者推进车内，命令司机驶往越界筑路区（O.J.L.）的引翔港村。汽车行驶至引翔港村以北约一英里的马耀山路（Ma Nyoh San Road）后停下，受害者和两名绑架者下车。车费付清后，车辆返回租界，受害者被带过一片田地，到达距路边约100码靠近一个小池塘的地方，在那里被枪击两次。随后（在此点上无法确定具体时间），受害者被一些乡下人看到，他们通知了

The victim stated two of his assailants were known to him as

second names were Ah Ling (阿利) and Ah Foh (阿福), also
that he believed that the attack was instigated by one Woo Tsu

At 11.15 a.m. 20-10-33, the D.D.O. "D", the undersigned,
C.D.S.I. Yang Ah Zien, C.D.C. 167 and the ricsha coolie above
mentioned proceeded to the place where the victim was placed in

No witnesses to the shooting were found and the Tei-Pao was

A minute search was made over a large area, but no cartridge
cases were found. Two Chinese detectives were left at the scene
to continue the search.

获悉用于此犯罪的车辆是12323号，由1900号司机陈永华（Ching Yoong Woo）驾驶，该车是于上午8时55分应电话呼叫被派往华界福佑路117号总工会的。司机被带到分局，他陈述说，当他沿福佑路行驶，距离总工会入口约50英尺时，看到三名男子站在路边，其中一人挥手示意他停车。他停下车，这三名男子上车，其中一人命令他驶往引翔港村。司机照办，途中穿过租界，并在华德路引翔港电话亭处离开租界。驶过引翔港村约一英里后，司机被告知停车，三人下车，其中一人支付了2.00元车费。付钱的人在车票上写下了以下内容：朱九林 九点三十分（Ts Chue Ling 9.30 a.m.）。随后司机调转车头，经马耀山路、控江路（Kon Kiang）和王兴路（Wong Shing Roads）返回租界。

Re AH FOH (阿福) mentioned above, this is believed to
refer to Tsu Ah Foh (朱阿福) residing 322 Tiendoong Road. He
is a member of the Workers Strike Committee and the Picketing
Group Committee. He has been very active during the present strike,
he was employed as a fitter at the Riverside. His home at the
above address is being kept under constant observation. The
victim and other loyal employees of the S.P.C. were publicly
denounced in the Shun Pao and other newspapers on the 17-10-33

关于上文提到的吴祖培（WOO TSU BAI），他在最近的罢工之前受雇于上海电力公司（Shanghai Power Co.）的职员薪资办公室，负责组建上海电力公司文职人员罢工委员会，并随后煽动文职人员罢工。据报吴居住于城内大南门内富民路英昌里 4 号。目前他住在旅馆中。年龄 28 至 31 岁，身高 5 英尺 6 英寸，中等身材，小脸，面色蜡黄，略有驼背，穿西装，戴角质框眼镜。颈部有疮。据信常出入劳合区（Louza district）的妓院。

关于上文提到的阿福（AH FOH），据信此人是居住在提篮桥路 322 号的朱阿福（Tsu Ah Foh）。他是工人罢工委员会和纠察队委员会的成员。在此次罢工期间表现非常活跃，此前受雇于 Riverside（音译：江边工厂/车间）担任钳工。其上述地址的住所正受到持续监视。受害者及其他上海电力公司的忠诚员工于 1933 年 10 月 17 日在《申报》及其他报纸上被公开谴责
